summary.score_status: Current figures are static-signal estimates of the local implementation, not measured rankings, traffic, conversions or local-pack performance.
summary.business_type: Single brick-and-mortar medical aesthetic / skin clinic (Healthcare, YMYL)
top_findings: Live placeholder case study and before/after placeholders are patient-visible and in metadata
Google Business Profile exists but has zero website integration and a false FAQ directions claim
NAP inconsistency: brand-name variants, phone without +91, unresolved PIN conflict 401105 vs 401107
Thin duplicate /treatment-type/* pages in sitemap with no canonical competing with real service pages
Minimal entity/E-E-A-T schema: no physician credentials, FAQPage, geo, hours, areaServed or review proof
quick_wins: Remove or noindex placeholder results page and hide unfinished before/after sections
Define one canonical NAP and correct Justdial/Practo + contact/directions links
Link the orphaned Mira Bhayander location page from nav, footer and homepage FAQ
Deploy expanded @graph schema (clinic + physician + FAQ + reviewed medical pages)
Fix 5 missing metas, duplicate titles, archive canonicals and 9 generic anchors

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt 200 with Allow: / and valid sitemap declaration
Valid 35-URL sitemap, 0 invalid/duplicate/cross-host URLs
All 10 sampled pages HTTP 200 with self-canonicals and no noindex
HTTPS + single-hop HTTP→HTTPS and www→apex redirects, valid TLS 1.3
Server-rendered content with raw/rendered parity, lightweight HTML

findings.title: Thin duplicate treatment-type pages without canonical
findings.description: 8 /treatment-type/* URLs in sitemap are 32-64 words with no canonical and duplicate titles/H1s against richer /treatment/* pages.
findings.recommendation: Canonical to matching /treatment/* page or noindex,follow and remove from sitemap.

findings.title: Orphaned local money page
findings.description: /skin-clinic-mira-bhayander/, /blog/ and results page are not linked from sampled navigation hubs.
findings.recommendation: Add crawlable nav/footer/contextual links.

findings.title: Missing security and cache headers
findings.description: HSTS, CSP, nosniff, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Cache-Control, ETag and Expires absent on tested responses.
findings.recommendation: Add after confirming subdomain HTTPS; long immutable cache for versioned assets, short revalidating cache for HTML.

findings.title: Image dimensions and lazy above-the-fold image
findings.description: 8/12 homepage and 11/19 treatments images lack width/height; /about/ lazy-loads its first image.
findings.recommendation: Add intrinsic dimensions or aspect-ratio; remove lazy from hero images.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage 1,114 words and location page 576 words
Medically sensible treatment sequencing and direct FAQ answers
All 6 priority treatments have dedicated URLs

findings.title: Live placeholder case study
findings.description: /results/acne-treatment-case-reference/ exposes consent-placeholder text in body and meta description (39 words).
findings.recommendation: Noindex/remove until real consented content exists; publish an educational alternative.

findings.title: YMYL E-E-A-T gap
findings.description: Dr Rishita Ray named but no degree, registration, experience, reviewer attribution or clinical citations; blog author is admin/Organization.
findings.recommendation: Add verified credentials, author/reviewer boxes, lastReviewed and authoritative citations.

findings.title: Templated thin treatment copy
findings.description: 6 priority pages are 364-397 words with identical 11-section skeleton (~84 shared 5-word sequences).
findings.recommendation: Expand to 700-1,000 words of condition-specific substance each.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: One H1 per page on all 18 sampled URLs
No heading-level skips on treatment pages
No mixed content

findings.title: Metadata gaps and duplicate titles
findings.description: 5 pages missing meta descriptions; home title 83 chars; treatment vs treatment-type titles/H1s identical; canonicals missing on blog index and archives.
findings.recommendation: Unique localised titles/metas, unique archive headings, add canonicals.

findings.title: Generic anchors and weak internal linking
findings.description: 9 'Learn more' anchors on homepage; treatment pages do not link to location page, FAQs or results page.
findings.recommendation: Descriptive anchors and contextual hub-and-spoke links.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: 0 invalid JSON-LD blocks across 18 sampled pages
BreadcrumbList on inner pages and BlogPosting on the post

findings.title: Extremely thin entity data sitewide
findings.description: Only homepage has clinic entity with streetAddress only; no geo, postalCode, hours, areaServed, @id, sameAs, Person, FAQPage, MedicalProcedure or MedicalWebPage.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the @graph pattern in findings/content-schema.md with verified facts only.

categories.name: Performance (estimated, not field-measured)
what_works: Small image bytes (hero ~64 KB, portrait ~147 KB)
Correct hero handling with fetchpriority=high and not lazy

findings.title: No field CWV data available
findings.description: No PSI/CrUX/GSC credentials; PSI returned 429. LCP/INP/CLS cannot be reported.
findings.recommendation: Connect a Google API key / GSC to measure field data.

findings.title: Render-blocking CSS and no cache headers
findings.description: 3 external stylesheets + 5 inline style blocks per page; no Cache-Control/ETag.
findings.recommendation: Inline critical CSS, defer non-critical, add cache headers.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Server-rendered, real 404s, permissive robots.txt with search/citation crawlers allowed
Clean accessibility tree: 0 unnamed interactive nodes, semantic landmarks
Direct quotable FAQ answers and named physician in copy

findings.title: No LLM discovery layer
findings.description: llms.txt 404, no text/markdown negotiation, no Vary: Accept, all /.well-known paths 404.
findings.recommendation: Add a short llms.txt as a low-cost discovery aid; not a ranking factor.

findings.title: Location page hidden from navigation
findings.description: 0 links to /skin-clinic-mira-bhayander/ from homepage nav/footer.
findings.recommendation: Add visible nav/footer/contextual links.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 12 homepage images with 0 missing alt; modest file sizes
Hero image correctly prioritised

findings.title: Live before/after placeholders
findings.description: Unfinished placeholder strings on acne treatment and results pages; no real results images.
findings.recommendation: Publish consented de-identified images or hide sections.

findings.title: Image hygiene gaps
findings.description: 8/12 homepage images lack dimensions; informative treatment images have empty alts; og:image missing on 8/10 pages.
findings.recommendation: Add dimensions, descriptive alts and 1200x630 og:image.

categories.name: Local SEO (goal-specific, separate score)
what_works: LocalIntent title on homepage and a 576-word location page
6 dedicated priority service pages
Visible NAP, hours and tel: link on contact page

findings.title: GBP zero website integration
findings.description: No map, place ID, GBP URL or review widget; FAQ falsely claims a Maps directions link exists.
findings.recommendation: Audit GBP, add directions link/lazy map, capture place ID.

findings.title: No review proof
findings.description: No rating/review schema or on-site testimonials; competitors show social proof.
findings.recommendation: Launch compliant steady review cadence and owner responses.

findings.title: NAP inconsistency and PIN conflict
findings.description: Brand variants, phone without +91, 401105 vs 401107 unresolved, directory name 'Lumiere Clinic'.
findings.recommendation: Define and propagate one verified canonical NAP.

findings.title: Doorway risk for corridor scaling
findings.description: One page per Western Railway station would be thin and fail the swap test.
findings.recommendation: Use one hub + 6 service spokes + at most 4-5 unique cluster pages.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Remove/noindex placeholder results page and before/after placeholders
Audit GBP categories, NAP, hours, photos and capture place ID/Insights
Define one verified canonical NAP and correct directories
Add real directions link and tel: link to contact/location pages
Link orphaned location page from nav/footer/homepage
Canonicalise or de-index thin treatment-type pages
Fix metas, duplicate titles and archive canonicals

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Deploy @graph schema with clinic, physician, FAQ and medical pages
Add credentials, reviewer attribution and clinical citations
Expand 6 priority treatment pages to 700-1,000 words
Launch compliant review cadence across 5 platforms
Publish consented results imagery or hide sections
Fix image dimensions, alts, lazy hero and og:image
Add security/cache headers and critical CSS

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Claim Bing Places, Apple Business, Facebook, Sulekha and aggregators
Build corridor hub + spokes + at most 4-5 unique cluster pages
Local digital PR and best-of list placements
Maintain locally relevant reviewed blog cadence

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Connect GSC, GA4, PSI/CrUX and GBP data sources
Run geo-grid rankings across Churchgate-Dahanu monthly
Monitor review velocity and NAP consistency
Capture SEO drift baseline and validate schema after deploy
Optional llms.txt discovery aid

implementation.status: Implemented and verified on local XAMPP copy only; not deployed to production.
implementation.rollback: Restore theme-ma-lumiere.zip over wp-content/themes/ma-lumiere and restore database.sql from the same backup.
completed: Removed patient-visible placeholder strings from database and theme templates; results page now contains educational copy without patient images or outcome claims.
Standardised NAP to PIN 401105, full verified address, +91 99878 02355 display and tel:+919987802355 links.
Added address-based Google Maps directions link; no Place ID or unverified GBP share URL used.
Added unique SEO titles and meta descriptions to homepage, About, Treatments, Booking, Contact, FAQs, Blog and location page.
Revised four treatment pillars with equal attention; Botox optimized on existing /treatment/injectables-facial-contouring/ URL.
Set nine treatment_category archives to noindex,follow with canonicals and sitemap exclusion; sitemap now has 29 URLs.
Linked /skin-clinic-mira-bhayander/ from footer and treatment pages, ending its orphan state.
Added linked JSON-LD: MedicalClinic+LocalBusiness, WebSite, Person (jobTitle Aesthetic Physician), WebPage, Service and BreadcrumbList; retained BlogPosting.
Deliberately omitted geo, structured hours, Place ID, reviews/ratings, FAQPage and MedicalProcedure markup.

verification.rendered_page_checks: 5/5 sampled URLs HTTP 200, canonicals/robots correct, 0 placeholders (findings/page-verification.txt)

owner_actions: Convert the supplied share URL to a canonical GBP/Maps URL and supply any genuine Place ID; never invent one.
Verify GBP categories, exact name, address, PIN, phone, hours, photos, posts and insights.
Launch compliant review acquisition with no incentives, gating or fabricated reviews.
Correct directory citations including Justdial/Practo variants and add only real sameAs URLs.
Supply verified credentials, clinical citations, reviewer attribution and any consented patient assets.
Connect GSC, GA4, GBP Insights and CrUX/PSI to replace static estimates with measured data.
Approve production deployment and take a fresh production backup and SEO-drift baseline.
implementation.faq_schema_decision: No FAQPage markup added because Google retired FAQ rich results in 2026; visible FAQs remain for users and agents.
